S.FORM: bniru:Sabi Nobu mwani qanim. cingay balay kinqbaqan mluw squ ziray kinhelaw mrkyas. AI qani ga mzyup squ qqnxan ta. kahul squ hngya'an na soci kmraw ita, tehuk squ pinkita nbu. ktan ta nyux s'unan AI kwara. mhtuw squ AI qani ga, balay nya, thuyay maras squ 'llaw na qqnxan, AI ga thuyay mha kbalay krahu na bbrwan, musa r'tung zikang ru cipuq squliq ka pincyawgan nya. kmraw squliq musa kbalay balay ru helaw na zywaw. ana ga, shbun inlungan squ AI qani uzi, myasa anzan na brwan ta nanak, smtama ta iyal AI ru ini ta qbaq mnglung ru mbiyaq mnglung ta nanak, ru cyawawgan ta baq rayri squ AI qani. kwara zywaw qani ga, siki musa ta bleqaw balay musa mita. nanu yasa, AI qani ga sazing squ zywaw qani , mya sa bleqaw ta cukaw ga, AI qani ga musa remuruw squ syakay ta. ana ga, ini ta leqi mita kinyaqih nya lga, musa maras squ giqas na kinqhut na zywaw. babaw nya, spiyang balay ga squliq ru AI msqun squ mcizywaw, yasa baq lmeliq ru lemrruw syakay ta.
S.PHON: βniru[s|ɕ]aβi noβu mwani qanim [ʦ|ʨ]iŋaj βalaj kinqβaqan mluw [s|ɕ]qu ziraj kinħelaw mrkja[s|ɕ] ai qani ɣa mzjup [s|ɕ]qu qqnxan ta kaħul [s|ɕ]qu ħŋjaʔan na [s|ɕ]o[ʦ|ʨ]i kmraw ita teħuk [s|ɕ]qu pinkita nβu ktan ta njux [s|ɕ]ʔunan ai kwara mħtuw [s|ɕ]qu ai qani ɣa βalaj nja tħujaj mara[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]qu ʔllaw na qqnxan ai ɣa tħujaj mħa kβalaj kraħu na ββrwan mu[s|ɕ]a rʔtuŋ zikaŋ ru [ʦ|ʨ]ipuq [s|ɕ]quliq ka pin[ʦ|ʨ]jawɣan nja kmraw [s|ɕ]quliq mu[s|ɕ]a kβalaj βalaj ru ħelaw na zjwaw ana ɣa [s|ɕ]ħβun inluŋan [s|ɕ]qu ai qani uzi mja[s|ɕ]a anzan na βrwan ta nanak [s|ɕ]mtama ta ijal ai ru ini ta qβaq mŋluŋ ru mβijaq mŋluŋ ta nanak ru [ʦ|ʨ]jawawɣan ta βaq rajri [s|ɕ]qu ai qani kwara zjwaw qani ɣa [s|ɕ]iki mu[s|ɕ]a ta βleqaw βalaj mu[s|ɕ]a mita nanu ja[s|ɕ]a ai qani ɣa [s|ɕ]aziŋ [s|ɕ]qu zjwaw qani mja [s|ɕ]a βleqaw ta [ʦ|ʨ]ukaw ɣa ai qani ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a remuruw [s|ɕ]qu [s|ɕ]jakaj ta ana ɣa ini ta leqi mita kinjaqiħ nja lɣa mu[s|ɕ]a mara[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]qu ɣiqa[s|ɕ] na kinqħut na zjwaw βaβaw nja [s|ɕ]pijaŋ βalaj ɣa [s|ɕ]quliq ru ai m[s|ɕ]qun [s|ɕ]qu m[ʦ|ʨ]izjwaw ja[s|ɕ]a βaq lmeliq ru lemrruw [s|ɕ]jakaj ta
